title.narrative: Renforcement des actions anticipatoires pour la prévention et la réponse aux violences basées sur le genre, des abus et exploitation sexuels et de la mortalité maternelle et néonatale liées à l’impact de El Nino dans trois districts du Grand Sud de Madag

description.narrative: The main objective of this project is to provide and reinforce anticipatory and early response actions for the prevention and response to gender-based violence, sexual abuse and exploitation, and maternal and neonatal mortality related to the impact of El in the Grand Sud of Madagascar. This UNFPA project provides critical community sensitization on GBV risks, reproductive health kits for emergency obstetric and neonatal care to facilities, refresher trainings for frontline responders on clinical management of rape and psychological first aid for survivors of GBV. The project provides life-saving assistance to 22,900 people, including 13,518 women, 2,763 men, 6,619 children, and 185 persons with disabilities.
